desc:
A ragdoll playground where every hit counts. Dummies have real bones and organs inside and react to exactly where and how you hit them.

🦴 Bones break, limbs fly off, heads crack - every body part reacts on its own
😵 Dummies stagger, get knocked out, fall over and get back up
⚔️ 60+ weapons: guns, katana, bow, traps, black hole gun, freeze ray and more
🏆 Kill milestones - unlock the Frying Pan, Fire Axe, Chainsaw, Laser Sword and Laser Gun
🌋 Huge events: Black Hole, Nuke, Meteor Shower, Fire Storm, Zero-G, Flash Freeze
🛝 Lava, quicksand and honey pits, a rocket, a train, a trampoline and a launch pad
🏍️ Ride mopeds, quads, buggies and army jeeps
🐢 Slow motion and doctor mode to see every injury up close
🏅 Weekly leaderboards for most kills and time played

🎮 Play on PC, Console, Phone and Tablet!

CODE: TWEET
